WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mt
    FROM cust
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(c.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM cust c
    JOIN mins m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.total = m.mt
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.amount > 0
ORDER BY b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT source
FROM income
WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 7

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name

SELECT b.category,
       SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted,
       (SELECT SUM(b2.amount)
          FROM budget b2
          JOIN event e2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
         WHERE e2.event_name = 'April Speaker') AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC

SELECT DISTINCT type
FROM event
WHERE location = 'MU 215'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(i.income_id) AS percentage
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium' AND m.position = 'Member'

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS bad_percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Amazo'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'durability'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id
JOIN colour h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id
WHERE e.colour = 'Blue' AND h.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero_name) AS blue_eyes_percentage
FROM superhero

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0)
        OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5))
)

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS avg_albumin
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT >= 60

SELECT CAST(substr(e.`Examination Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age,
       e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    ORDER BY HGB DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT L.ID,
       L.Date,
       L.UA,
       P.SEX,
       CASE
           WHEN (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS within_normal_range
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ID = 57266
  AND L.UA IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.ID,
       strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.WBC > 3.5 AND L.WBC < 9.0
  AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP = '+' AND p.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.molecule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'f'
) f ON m.molecule_id = f.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT COUNT(bond_id) AS connection_count
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%\_19' ESCAPE '\'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND m.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT c.name AS circuit,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
       r.year,
       lt.time AS lap_record_time,
       lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds)
      FROM lapTimes lt2
      JOIN races r2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId
      WHERE r2.circuitId = c.circuitId
  )
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

SELECT f.`School Name`,
       f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid

SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId

FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year
FROM yearmonth AS y
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'

SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS highest_monthly_consumption

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description

FROM Player
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
       OR height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),

    SELECT e.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM extremes e
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = e.player_api_id
    GROUP BY e.player_api_id, e.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM avg_finishing
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT c1.Segment, c1.total
    FROM cons c1
    WHERE c1.total = (
        SELECT MIN(c2.total)
        FROM cons c2
        WHERE c2.Segment = c1.Segment
    )
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM mins
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME
